facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: danger tagging failure on CY-3211

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on CY-3211 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on CY-3211 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. CY-3211 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 18 February 2009 an incident occurred on CY-3211 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
